title: lidarmetricpy: GPU computation of lidR-compatible forest-structure metrics from airborne LiDAR

creators.name: Doi, Hideyuki
creators.affiliation: Graduate School of Informatics, Kyoto University

description: GPU/CPU Python package that computes forest-structure metrics per grid cell from airborne LiDAR point clouds: 146 outputs, i.e. all 111 outputs of lidRmetrics::metrics_set3, 9 tree summaries of lidR's segmentation workflow, 17 metrics of leafR, PyForestScan, forestr and ForestGapR, and 9 canopyLazR rasters, each equal to the original package. The validation files (incl. data thinned to 2, 5 and 10 points per m2) and the list of all outputs are part of the archive.
